fields.title: Google Maps popular-times record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of Google's foot-traffic data. In wide format one PLACE row per venue holds the whole weekly curve; in long format one POPULAR_TIMES_HOUR row per venue/day/hour. ERROR rows carry _error instead of a payload. Google adds and removes fields without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The query or identifier that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-preview-place, or none on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: PLACE (wide format), POPULAR_TIMES_HOUR (long format), or ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: search_failed, unresolvable_input or detail_failed.

name.title: Venue name
name.description: Business name as shown on Google Maps.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Real GPS latitude of the venue.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Real GPS longitude of the venue.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone -- needed to interpret the hourly curve locally.

googleMapsUrl.title: Google Maps URL
googleMapsUrl.description: Canonical Maps link for the venue.

reviewsCount.title: Reviews count
reviewsCount.description: Total Google reviews -- a rough proxy for venue size.

openingHours.title: Opening hours
openingHours.description: Weekly schedule, where Google supplied it.

hasPopularTimes.title: Has popular times
hasPopularTimes.description: Whether Google returned a foot-traffic curve for this venue.

popularTimes.title: Popular times
popularTimes.description: Wide format: seven day objects, each with dayNumber (1=Monday), hasData, peakHour, peakOccupancyPercent and an hours list of {hour, occupancyPercent, label, displayHour}.

daysWithData.title: Days with data
daysWithData.description: How many of the seven days carry a curve.

busiestDay.title: Busiest day
busiestDay.description: Day containing the highest occupancy reading.

peakOccupancyPercent.title: Peak occupancy %
peakOccupancyPercent.description: Highest occupancy reading across the week, 0-100.

averageOccupancyPercent.title: Average occupancy %
averageOccupancyPercent.description: Mean occupancy across every hour Google reports.

hasLiveData.title: Has live data
hasLiveData.description: True only for a real live measurement. A 'Now: ...' status line is a projection from the weekly curve and does not count.

liveOccupancyPercent.title: Live occupancy %
liveOccupancyPercent.description: Current occupancy 0-100, when Google has a live reading.

liveHour.title: Live hour
liveHour.description: Hour (0-23) the live reading refers to.

liveStatusText.title: Live status text
liveStatusText.description: Google's wording, e.g. 'Less busy than usual' or 'Now: Usually as busy as it gets'.

currentDay.title: Current day
currentDay.description: Day number (1=Monday) at scrape time, per the venue's own timezone.

currentHour.title: Current hour
currentHour.description: Hour (0-23) at scrape time, per the venue's own timezone.

day.title: Day
day.description: Long format: day name for this row.

displayHour.title: Display hour
displayHour.description: Long format: Google's own label for the hour, e.g. '6 am'.

occupancyPercent.title: Occupancy %
occupancyPercent.description: Long format: busyness for this venue/day/hour, 0-100.

label.title: Busyness label
label.description: Long format: e.g. 'Usually a little busy'. Empty when the venue is closed that hour.

isPeakHour.title: Is peak hour
isPeakHour.description: Long format: whether this hour is that day's peak.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both output formats.

weekly.title: Weekly curves (wide)
weekly.description: One row per venue with its weekly foot-traffic summary.

hourly.title: Hourly rows (long)
hourly.description: One row per venue/day/hour -- the analysis-ready shape.
